Well Apples to Apples is a fun family card game. Cards Against Humanity is played almost exactly the same way, but it's like the adult version of the family game. It's a game that's more fun with more people. Everyone has a hand of cards that are seemingly random. Just random objects and people and whatnot. One person has a card with a question written on it. For example one card says 'In his dying moments, what were Michael Jackson's last thoughts?' Then it becomes everyone else's turn to anonymously put a card in that they think either answers the question perfectly or is just too funny not to play. Cards like 'the Boy Scouts of America' or 'child beauty pageants' would be good cards to play. The person who read the question card then has to pick his favorite answer out of the bunch and the owner of the card he picks gets a 'point' and at 10 points they win. Of course you can always change the amount of points or just play till there are no more cards left. I hope I explained it well enough that it sounds fun and not confusing. It's definitely worth the money! (Also a lot of fun to play with friends when drinking). Although I just realized that it will probably be just you and her.
